notes: Captured all 184 decors listed on /products/ldsp/ (Sept 2026; 113 Древесные, 34 Фоновые, 6 Металлик, 31 Фантазийные; collections Ведута 8, Шале 8, Хюгге 7, Иллюзия 9, rest 'Без коллекции' or unassigned=null). decorCode kept exactly as published (site writes 'U9118' without space; some have suffixes like 'U2264/М', 'U1605/P/M', 'U7508/IP'; a few are non-U codes '15-651070-111' or two-sided combos like 'U1605+U1607', '15-651070-110+U1655/М'). Structure: the site gives per-decor «Рекомендуемое тиснение» (recommended embossing, often several). EXTRA FIELD structureCodes lists them all; structureCode is set only when exactly one is listed, else null. Legend (reference page): PR поры дерева, PE шагрень, TS натуральный шпон, WE офисная шагрень, WS шпон, LF лофт, EW эдель вуд, SM1 гладкий шелк, FR ферро, MP матовые поры. Extra fields exclusive / edgeAvailable = the site's «Эксклюзив» / «Кромка» flags. Sizes: no per-decor thickness/format anywhere on the site; filled range-wide from reference page (2750x1830; thickness list taken from the 'Нормы загрузки ЛДСП формат 2750*1830' table: 8,10,12,16,18,22,25,32,38 — GOST table says 'от 8 до 40'). Actual per-decor availability of thicknesses is NOT published. Grain: Древесные→wood, Фоновые→none; Металлик and Фантазийные→unknown (grainBasis names the category). Edges: 99 edge items from /products/kromki/; material not stated on catalogue pages (unknown). Suffix in parentheses (П, Гл, Ш, Лф, Фр, Шпон) is the site's own finish marker, not decoded. Matches set ONLY where edge name and number equal an LDSP decor name and U-number on the same site (87 of 99); others (e.g. 'Айрон Рок 3705' vs LDSP Айрон Рок U9712, 'Белая 2 1655' vs 'Белый U1655/М', 'Серая 9201' vs 'Серый U9201/M') left [] because name or number differs. No MDF/HDF on this site (only ДСП/ЛДСП).
